nav.label: Help and settings
help.title: How the bot works
help.intro: I run giveaways under posts in Telegram channels. Subscribers tap a button under the post to join, and I draw the winners at random.
help.step1: Add me to your channel as an admin with two permissions:
help.rightPostWhy: to publish the results under the post
help.rightEditWhy: to put the join button under the post
help.step2: In this app, tap “New giveaway” and paste the link to the giveaway post. I add a join button under it.
help.step3: When the giveaway ends, I draw the winners and send you “📱 Review in the app”. See which winners are subscribed to your channel, replace one if needed, and publish the results.
help.partner1: A partner channel adds me as an admin with every permission off. Telegram tells only admins who is subscribed to a channel, and that is all I need.
help.partner2: The partner channel then shows in the results review of every giveaway I run, with each winner's subscription to it. To end the partnership, the partner removes me from the admins.
